title: MotionGraphicsBench: Evaluating Motion Graphics Generation with Programmatic Verification
abstract: arXiv:2611.10592v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models can generate motion graphics from static images and natural language requests, but it remains difficult to evaluate how well models follow requests that combine spatial, appearance, and temporal requirements. We introduce MotionGraphicsBench, an expert-curated benchmark of 100 instances for animating an input static SVG with a motion edit prompt. By supplying all required visual elements, our editing task reflects a designer-like workflow and isolates motion generation from graphic generation. Derived from real-world Lottie motion designs, our benchmark contains diverse combinations of spatio-temporal animation behaviors. Each benchmark instance pairs its model input with a deterministic, human-readable verification program that accepts different valid implementations and reports which prompt requirements pass or fail, rather than comparing against a reference animation or using a VLM judge. translated_title: MotionGraphicsBench：基于程序化验证的动态图形生成评估
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型可以根据静态图像和自然语言请求生成动态图形，但评估模型对结合空间、外观和时间要求的请求的遵循程度仍然困难。我们提出了MotionGraphicsBench，这是一个由专家精心策划的基准测试，包含100个实例，用于根据运动编辑提示对输入的静态SVG进行动画处理。通过提供所有所需的视觉元素，我们的编辑任务反映了类似设计师的工作流程，并将运动生成与图形生成分离开来。该基准测试源自真实世界的Lottie运动设计，包含多样化的时空动画行为组合。每个基准实例都将模型输入与一个确定性的、人类可读的验证程序配对，该程序接受不同的有效实现并报告哪些提示要求通过或失败，而不是与参考动画进行比较或使用视觉语言模型（VLM）作为评判。
tldr: 提出了MotionGraphicsBench基准，通过确定性程序化验证评估大模型根据自然语言提示为静态SVG生成动态图形动画的能力，避免了参考动画对比或VLM评判的主观性。
en_tdlr: Introduces MotionGraphicsBench, a 100-instance benchmark that evaluates LLM motion graphics generation from static SVGs and natural language prompts using deterministic programmatic verification instead of reference comparison or VLM judges.
